purpose: A-side receive/relay of the B->A gift-wrapped decline DM (DD-4/DD-7/DD-10). Adds an INVITE_DECLINE_KIND branch to the existing kind-1059 gift-wrap dispatch in welcomeSubscription.ts (slotted after the join-request 21059 branch, before the kind-444 Welcome guard), reusing unwrapGiftWrap's existing seal authentication. On an authenticated decline: defers until the referenced group's historical sync completes (onHistorySynced) without ever advancing the MLS key schedule early; verifies the lowercased seal author is currently a pending member of that group (isPendingMemberImpl); then executes, in order, (1) MLS Remove of the invitee reusing cancelPendingInvitationImpl but emitting a `declined` invite_lifecycle announcement instead of `invite_cancelled`, (2) clear the pending-direct-invite marker, (3) mark the gift wrap seen — never marking seen before step (1)/(2) complete, so a crash mid-flow safely reprocesses on next start and a replay after B is already removed is a clean no-op. Two genuinely distinct decline wraps for the same invitee/group are serialized per-(groupId,pubkey) to converge on exactly one Remove + one post.

public_api.description: NEW exported type. Extends cancelInvitationImpl.ts's (now-exported) Deps with the two capabilities the Remove machinery doesn't own: posting an application rumor into an ARBITRARY group by id (this is a background listener, not scoped to one open group's UI) and clearing the pending-direct-invite marker (owned by pendingDirectInviteStorage.ts, consumed here only via injection per architecture.md's boundary rule).

public_api.name: cancelPendingInvitationImpl
public_api.signature: (deps: Deps, groupId: string, pubkey: string, sendAnnouncement?: (content: string) => Promise<void>, announcementKind?: 'invite_cancelled' | 'declined' = 'invite_cancelled') => Promise<{ ok, error?, raceDetected?, announcementError? }>
public_api.description: Existing export (cancelInvitationImpl.ts), extended with one new optional trailing param, announcementKind, defaulted to 'invite_cancelled' so the pre-existing admin-initiated Cancel-Invite/Remove-Member flow (epic invite-rescind-and-member-removal) is byte-for-byte unchanged. When 'declined', emits `{type:'invite_lifecycle', event:'declined', pubkey}` (no `by` field) instead of `{type:'invite_cancelled', pubkey, by}` — reusing the SAME Remove-commit-then-announce machinery (ADR-010).
